## How it was tested

- [ ] `pnpm build` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] `pnpm test:url-first` (if checkers, scoring, reports or URL-first flow changed)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test that fails without the change

## Checklist

- [ ] Wording uses glossary terms (`CONTEXT.md`)
- [ ] ADR added or updated, if this changes architecture, safety or product behavior
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/API.md`, `docs/CONFIGURATION.md`, README as needed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] No secrets or generated output in the diff
- [ ] Safety model unchanged, or the change is explained and tested (`SECURITY.md`)
